title: Artless Sprite Grayt 30A Vacations
description_expanded: AboutArtless Sprite ~ 156 Garfield Street ~ Grayton Beach FL 32459 Need a last-minute stay? Please call our office at 844-941-1213 to make last-minute bookings via telephone, as availability within the next 7-nights will not show on calendar. We do not allow online bookings within 7-nights/one week of an arrival date. 20% Discount off Spring Rates! 3-night minimum with flexible arrival/departure days. Valid on new bookings only for stays completed prior to May 22nd. Discount is reflected in online pricing. Artless Sprite is a historic Grayton Beach bungalow, completely renovated from the studs and professionally decorated. This charming, luxurious 1,232sf bungalow has 2 baths and sleeps 8 in 3 bedrooms. Public beach access at Western Lake less than a 3-minute walk, passing local icon The Red Bar along the way. Experience Old Grayton at its finest! Artless Sprite borders the Grayton Beach State Park, named America’s #1 Beach in 2020 by Dr. Stephen Leatherman, aka Dr. Beach! “This beach boasts of its sugar-white sand and emerald green water where development has been restrained so big sand dunes still dominate the landscape. At the same time, all the amenities of great restaurants and accommodations are close by in the old town of Grayton Beach or Seaside," wrote Leatherman. Originally named the country’s top beach in 1994, Grayton Beach State Park has been listed FOUR times since 1991, finishing 6th in 2016 and 3rd in 2019. Main Level: Open plan living, fully equipped kitchen, dining for 8, 3 bedrooms, 2 baths. #1 En-Suite (Master) Bedroom has a King bed, walk-in shower, double vanity. #2 Bedroom has a Queen bed. #3 Bedroom has 2 Bunks (4 XL Twins) Full bath is shared by #2 and #3 Bedrooms, with tub/shower Amenities: Business Features Hi-Speed Wireless Internet (password secured) Entertainment Features 4 Flat Screen Smart TVs Distinctive Features 3-minute walk to beach at Western Lake access 2-minute walk to The Red Bar and The Zoo Gallery Prime historic Grayton location Bed, bath and kitchen linens provided Beach Gear Credit General Features Parking for 2 vehicles. 1 King bed, 1 Queen bed, 2 Bunks (4 XL Twins) 2 full bathrooms, iron, ironing board, 2 hair dryers, outdoor gas grill w/ grill utensils, outdoor porches, porch furniture, outdoor shower. Outdoor security cameras (at southeast corner and rear eave facing shed). Linens provided. No Smoking. No Pets. Kitchen Features Fully equipped kitchen, brand new Cafe appliances including gas range with griddle, French door fridge with hot/cold water dispenser, dishwasher and over-range microwave, farmhouse sink, quartz countertops, coffee maker, toaster, blender, washer, dryer. Area Features TimpoocheeTrail (30A bike path) Seaside (2 miles) State Parks (Tops’l, Grayton Beach, Deer Lake)
